positioning.launchPromise: Go live in 2-3 working days after Meta, Google, Razorpay, and required business access are ready.
positioning.successProof: A patient can ask on WhatsApp, select a service and slot, pay the booking fee, receive confirmation, cancel within policy, and see the booking reflected in dashboard, Calendar, and Sheet.

commercialTerms.metaMessageFees: Charged separately as used by category and country.

clinicPolicy.refundRule: If there is a valid issue after payment, the clinic can process a refund according to its policy.
clinicPolicy.noShowHandling: Mark no-show in dashboard and keep the patient conversation for follow-up.

expectedFlow: Patient asks for an appointment on WhatsApp.
ClinicGPT asks for the service and offers available slots.
ClinicGPT holds the slot for 10 minutes.
ClinicGPT sends a Razorpay payment link for Rs. 500.
Payment is captured and the booking is confirmed.
Google Calendar receives the appointment event.
Google Sheet receives the booking row.
Reminder is sent before the appointment.
Patient can cancel up to 2 hours before the appointment.
After completion, ClinicGPT sends a feedback or review request.

messageToneExamples.confirmation: Hello Aisha, your dental cleaning appointment with Aarogya Smile Clinic is confirmed for tomorrow at 6:30 PM. Please reply CANCEL at least 2 hours before the appointment if you need to cancel.
messageToneExamples.paymentRequest: Hello Aisha, please complete the Rs. 500 booking fee to confirm your dental cleaning appointment for tomorrow at 6:30 PM. Your slot is held for 10 minutes.
messageToneExamples.cancellation: Hello Aisha, your appointment has been cancelled. If a refund is applicable, the clinic team will process it as per policy.
messageToneExamples.review: Hello Aisha, thank you for visiting Aarogya Smile Clinic. We would appreciate your feedback here: https://g.page/r/demo-clinic-review
